turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're moving at the end of the month and I'm dreading the packing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's a big job. Do you want to hire movers to pack for you, or do it yourselves and save the money?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I have twenty seconds to think? Ask me again after.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, hire movers to do the packing, or tackle it yourselves?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We'll do it ourselves. Movers are so expensive.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Start with the rooms you use least, a few boxes each evening.
